name: cityhash64_v1
note: Renamed from wyhash_v1 on 2026-09-25. All five constants are CityHash64 (Google/Abseil) standard constants and the mixing function is HashLen16. The original rule mislabelled this family as a WyHash variant, and no WyHash constant was ever verified present in any scanned binary.

negative_patterns._comment: A hit on any of these is more consistent with WyHash; do not classify as CityHash64 in that case

min_hits_note: Any of the 5 constants counts; >=4 recommended to avoid coincidental constant collisions
